name: Center International Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Center International Group Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, and manufacturing of metal building cladding systems. The company also delivers integrated services for steel structures, covering engineering design, production, and construction. Its diverse project experience extends across numerous industrial sectors, including automotive, machinery, electrical and electronic, chemical and metallurgical, food and pharmaceutical, logistics, and power plants. Additionally, it undertakes projects for commercial office spaces and public buildings. Founded in 2001, the company operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.
